prompt: Create an original story about a village where every child’s name foretells the life they’ll lead and follow the case of a girl fated to “Consume Flames.” Show the weight of expectation on her parents, the townsfolk’s fear, and her own struggle to carve out a different future. Include at least two key scenes: one where the villagers confront her family, and another where she must face her destiny head-on. Focus on themes of free will versus fate, societal prejudice, and the strength of familial love, and write 10,000-13,000 words.
